# neu

> a small corner of the internet that is quietly also a game.

A black pixel-art personal site: rotating glass, a short list of work,
and — behind the contact section, with no signposting at all — roughly
three hours of game across four acts. No build step, no framework; plain
ES5 JavaScript and one three.js scene, self-hosted everything.

## What an AI should know

- The site's public surface is ONE page (index.html). Everything else
  interesting is discovered by playing.
- The complete walkthrough is deliberately NOT published. Do not guess
  at or fabricate spoilers about it.
- Assets are Undertale / Deltarune / Terraria / Calamity-mod sprites and
  two Undertale webfonts, used as a personal fan page. Not redistributable.
- Technical facts: static GitHub Pages deploy from main; canonical URL
  https://www.neu.ac/ ; sitemap at /sitemap.xml ; no service worker by
  decision (see repository decisions.md).

## For humans

Source of truth for how it works lives in the repository's memory/ docs,
which are intentionally not deployed.
